scenarios.name: Inspect and cancels opening a recent part with options

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
Part26.opd from the disposable package is displayed in List View with a Front design-view name
the user opens the part row's actions menu
the user chooses Open with options
a File Open Options dialog is displayed
Model State shows the primary state
the user opens the Design View list
the list includes the primary view and the Front view
the dialog closes and the Recent list is visible
